gamerule.social_contract.do_villager_ill: Determines whether Villagers will convert to Illagers when they are low enough on Happiness
gamerule.social_contract.max_room_volume: Determines how much volume the scoring algorithm will search before concluding that the room is not enclosed
gamerule.social_contract.max_villager_wo: The distance a Villager can wonder from its Bed, if it has one.
gamerule.social_contract.room_rescore_co: The Time interval before a room can be rescored
gamerule.social_contract.villager_death_: The radius in which a Villager's death will influence nearby Villagers' Happiness
